perks.name: SLASHED Pricing
perks.description: Starting slayer quests is half price.

perks.name: Pathfinder
perks.description: Gain +20 Magic Find, doubled on Slayer Bosses.

perks.name: Mining Fiesta
perks.description: Gain +25☯ Mining Wisdom, +25%  Mining Fortune, and collect Refined Minerals and Glossy Gemstones from mining!

perks.name: Molten Forge
perks.description: Decrease the time it takes to forge items by 25%.

perks.name: Huntress' Intuition
perks.description: Gain +10 Tracking.

perks.name: Mythological Ritual
perks.description: Minister Diana will sell the Griffin Pet, which lets you find Mythological Creatures and tons of unique items.

perks.name: Pet XP Buff
perks.description: Gain 35% more pet XP.

perks.name: Sharing is Caring
perks.description: Unlocks 2 more Exp Share slots in your pets menu and increases the Exp Share rate by +10%!

perks.name: Shopping Spree
perks.description: Increase daily NPC buy limits by 10x.

perks.name: Stock Exchange
perks.description: Participate in the Stonks Auction for a chance to win Stock of Stonks! Trade them for extravagant items at the Trade Center.

perks.name: Volume Trading
perks.description: The available item quantity per Shen's Auction has been doubled, and two additional Shen's Special auctions will be available if Diaz is Mayor.

perks.name: Long Term Investment
perks.description: The elected minister will appear as a candidate with all of their perks in the next election cycle.

perks.name: Pest Eradicator
perks.description: The duration of Pesthunter Phillip's  Farming Fortune bonus is now 60m. Decreases the spawn cooldown of Pests by 20%.

perks.name: GOATed
perks.description: Jacob's Farming Contest brackets include up to 10% more players each.

perks.name: Blooming Business
perks.description: All Garden Visitors reward Fine Flour and +10% Copper for accepting offers. Invites 5 unique visitors to your Garden and makes higher rarity visitors 20% more likely to show up.

perks.name: Grand Feast
perks.description: Finnegan upgrades the Harvest Feast into the Grand Feast, making it last a full SkyBlock year. Also opens the Grand Bakery, where Kernels can be spent on more exclusive items.

perks.name: A Time for Giving
perks.description: Spawn Party Chests by killing mobs during the Spooky Festival and collect Party Gifts from Jerry's Workshop.

perks.name: Fishing Festival
perks.description: Start a special fishing event the first 3 days of each month!

perks.name: Marauder
perks.description: Dungeon reward chests are 20% cheaper.

perks.name: EZPZ
perks.description: Gain 10 bonus score on dungeon runs.

perks.name: Perkpocalypse
perks.description: Activates all perks of another mayor every 18 SkyBlock days (6 hours).

perks.name: Statspocalypse
perks.description: Increases all Combat and Miscellaneous stats by 10%.

perks.name: Jerrypocalypse
perks.description: Reveal hidden Jerries from logging, farming, mining and killing mobs.

perks.name: Bribe
perks.description: If Scorpius wins and you voted for him, Mayor Scorpius will offer you coins as a token of gratitude.

perks.name: Darker Auctions
perks.description: Scorpius will intrude in Dark Auctions, increasing the amount of rounds to 7 and offering special items.
